integrity: The infinite recurrences are certified by exact integer linear-state checks plus Cayley--Hamilton; a separate finite recurrence replay is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem uses the explicit morphic identity proved in arXiv:2609.33421v1. It does not determine factor frequencies of length at least three or a full dynamical coding.
title: A sixth-order transition recurrence and exact bigram law for the Padovan-automatic difference word
